title: refactor(Development/AutomorphicArithmetic/AutomorphicVarieties/UnitaryThreeGroups): reuse QuadMu.quadMu in eta_killsMu
body:
Delegate the quadratic-extension Galois-containment step of `UpperTheory.V.U3.eta_killsMu` in `SubSmulMulSubSmulEqZeroOfQuadratic.lean` to `UpperTheory.V.Sd.Tw.quadMu` from `IdeleGenerators/TorsionOrderFrobenius/QuadMu.lean`, eliminating the duplicated private discriminant and root-fixing lemmas.

Removed private declarations in `UpperTheory.V.U3.EtaMu`:
- `Fx`
- `fx_of`, `fx_mul`, `fx_one`, `fx_pow`, `fx_four`, `fix_dvd`, `fx_neg_one`, `fx_two`, `fx_odd`, `fx_disc`
- `sub_smul_mul_sub_smul_eq_zero_of_quadratic`
